questions.stem: Identify the correct statements about the deterministic effects of radiation. It is associated with damage to the DNA of cells. The severity of these effects is independent of the dose received. Examples include oligospermia, skin erythema, and epilation. Below the threshold dose, harmful effects do not occur. The fetus is more vulnerable to these effects between the 2nd to 20th week of gestation
questions.stemHtml:
Identify the correct statements about the deterministic effects of radiation.

  1. It is associated with damage to the DNA of cells.
  2. The severity of these effects is independent of the dose received.
  3. Examples include oligospermia, skin erythema, and epilation.
  4. Below the threshold dose, harmful effects do not occur.
  5. The fetus is more vulnerable to these effects between the 2nd to 20th week of gestation
